messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need a single inventory + ownership for runtime signals that feed the new reliability dashboard. Focus: timeouts, 5xx classes, OOMs, degraded-mode / fallback counts. I sketched a candidate list below.
kevin: +1. Can you call out which team emits which raw signal? that's been the biggest gap.
sarah: Also need the exact telemetry format (labels/tags) so platform can wire up dashboards without hand-holding.
jon: From dashboard POV: we want 1) per-route 5xx rate, 2) timeout percent (p95 req latency > SLO), 3) fallback rate (fallbacks / total requests), 4) OOM spikes (count + affected hosts). Keep panels composable.
randall: Danger: double-counting fallbacks if both runtime and gateway log them. Need canonical producer.
maria: Proposed split:
- eng-runtime: emits counters/histograms for request lifecycle (request_received, request_latencies_ms histogram, response_code counter with code label), and fallback counter per request path.
- eng-infra: emits container OOM events, GPU OOMs, node memory pressure alerts.
- eng-platform: owner of aggregated metrics and dashboard panels, and of dedupe rules + tagging conventions.
kevin: Naming proposal (Prom-style):
```
# Counters
redwood_runtime_response_total{code="500",route="/v1/generate",model="gpt-open-1",region="us-west-2"} 42
redwood_runtime_fallbacks_total{route="/v1/generate",fallback_type="small_model",customer_tier="enterprise"} 5
# OOM events (ingested from infra as events)
redwood_infra_oom_events_total{host="gpu-32-1",reason="cuda_oom"} 1
```
kevin: Use `route`, `model`, `model_variant`, `region`, `customer_tier` tags. keep cardinality bounded by not tagging with request_id or arbitrary user ids.
sarah: For logs/events we prefer JSON envelope like:
```
{"ts":"2024-11-01T14:12:01Z","source":"runtime","event":"fallback","route":"/v1/generate","fallback_type":"cached_model","model":"gpt-open-1","region":"us-west-2","count":1}
```
sarah: Platform will accept either Prom metrics or structured events; we need a mapping doc.
jon: Panel queries (draft):
- 5xx rate per route: sum(rate(redwood_runtime_response_total{code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_runtime_response_total[5m]))
- fallback rate: sum(rate(redwood_runtime_fallbacks_total[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_runtime_response_total[5m]))
- timeout percent: count_over_time(redwood_runtime_request_timeouts_total[5m]) / sum(rate(redwood_runtime_response_total[5m]))
jon: We'll need sample dashboards for infra vs runtime views and a combined reliability heatmap.
randall: On dedupe: recommend runtime emits `fallback_observed_by="runtime"` label and gateway includes `fallback_observed_by="gateway"`. Platform dedupe rule: prefer runtime if present, otherwise gateway. We should add a unique `canonical_source` tag during ingest.
maria: Decision: canonical producers = runtime for request-level signals, infra for host-level signals (OOMs). Platform will enrich and dedupe at ingest. Ownership: eng-runtime -> implement metrics + PR by EOD Friday; eng-infra -> OOM event contract by Monday; eng-platform -> ingestion + dashboards by next Tues.
kevin: One more: record whether fallback triggered before or during generation (prefix cache vs post-generation). Add `fallback_stage` label with values `prefetch|generation|postprocess`.
sarah: For storage/retention: platform wants 90d for counters/histograms, 365d for OOM events. Is that OK infra? @randall
randall: 90d/365d sounds fine but infra will need cost estimate. I'll get a rough number today.
maria: Action list:
- eng-runtime (maria): implement metrics + labels PR (due 2024-11-08)
- eng-infra (randall): OOM event schema + cost estimate (due 2024-11-04)
- eng-platform (jon/sarah): ingestion pipeline + dedupe rules + dashboard skeleton (due 2024-11-12)
- kevin: review naming and cardinality limits (ASAP)
jon: I'll create the dashboard repo PR with panels + export JSON template for review.
deploy-bot: deploy: dashboards/service-reliability updated in staging (build 2024-10-31-847)
maria: Thanks — we'll sync async. If no objections I’ll open the tasks in Jira and tag owners.
kevin: sounds good :+1:
randall: thanks, will post infra cost numbers later today.
